fields.name: Shaniwar Wada
fields.description: 18th-century Maratha palace fort known for its massive gates and rich history. Built in 1732 by Peshwa Baji Rao I, it was once the seat of the Peshwa empire.
fields.tips: Visit during evening for light show. Avoid weekends.
fields.funFact: The fort is believed to be haunted by the ghost of Narayanrao.

fields.name: Dagdusheth Ganpati
fields.description: Famous Ganesha temple known for its gold idol and grand Ganesh festival celebrations.
fields.tips: Visit early morning to avoid crowd.
fields.funFact: The idol is adorned with over 40kg gold.

fields.name: Khadakwasla Dam
fields.description: Scenic dam known for sunset views and peaceful environment. Popular picnic spot.
fields.tips: Best during sunset. Avoid late night.
